inference_status: exploratory diagnostic; cannot revise the completed confirmation result

windows.matched_early_recovery: post-pulse interval equal to that trial's pulse duration

amplitude_qualification.threshold: channel-specific 20th percentile of control analytic amplitude during the 72-second pre-pulse baseline
amplitude_qualification.pair_time_validity: both members of an edge must exceed their own channel threshold in the control trajectory

phase_distance: one minus mean cosine of intervention-minus-control relative-phase difference over valid edge-times

diagnostic_decision.genuine_dissociation: gain pattern persists in pulse-matched amplitude-qualified all-edge phase and is not explained by common-mode fraction alone
diagnostic_decision.phase_estimation_artifact: gain pattern substantially collapses after amplitude qualification and tracks invalid-phase fraction
diagnostic_decision.spatially_localized: qualified effect survives primarily in one prespecified edge class
diagnostic_decision.mixed_or_inconclusive: none of the above patterns is clearly supported

prohibitions: do not alter the parent confirmation result
do not optimize the amplitude percentile
do not select a preferred pulse sign, duration, site, or seed
do not call this a new confirmation test
